title: Understanding Bootstrap Replicates
text: Bootstrap replicates are samples drawn with replacement from the original data. In this problem, each row represents a bootstrap replicate.

title: Interpreting the Table
text: The table shows bootstrap replicates in rows. Each row represents a different replicate, and the columns show the values drawn in each replicate.

title: Confidence Intervals and True Population Variance
text: A 50% confidence interval means that if you were to draw many samples and calculate the interval each time, about 50% of those intervals would contain the true population parameter.

title: Evaluating the Statement
text: Does drawing more bootstrap replicates increase the probability that the confidence intervals contain the true population variance?
